Citing pyCBS
============

If you use pyCBS in your research, please cite the main software paper:

**pyCBS: A Python Tool for CBS extrapolations** *A. Guerra-Barroso; F.J. Delgado-Alpízar; [cite_start]A.J.C. Varandas, JCTC, 2026* `DOI: 10.xxxx/xxxxxxx` [cite: 1]

.. code-block:: bibtex

   @article{pycbs2026,
     author = {A. Guerra-Barroso and F.J. Delgado-Alpízar and A.J.C. Varandas},
     title = {pyCBS: A Python Tool for CBS extrapolations},
     journal = {JCTC},
     year = {2026},
     volume = {XX},
     pages = {XXXX},
     doi = {10.xxxx/xxxxxxx}
   }

----------------------
